reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance and names the decisive gap. Price ($290, buyers paying for comparable workbooks), conversion (6/50 = 12% on this offer's own sales), Brain fulfilment (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET), $4 cost, $0 exposure and 3-day settlement are evidenced. $3,500 / $290 = 12.07, so 13 sales (net $286 each: 13 x 286 = $3,718); at 12% that is about 109 contacts. The only buyer count is Brain's RECOMMENDATION (~400 agencies), which is an estimate, so MARKET_VOLUME is unestablished. It is a countable fact (a licensing register or association directory), not something only a live test measures, so CONDITIONAL would be wrong; researching the count is the correct next step.
findings: Recomputed: 13 sales needed (12 x $290 = $3,480 < $3,500); ~109 contacts at 12%.
buyerVolume is RECOMMENDATION-only; the plan correctly treats reachable buyers as UNKNOWN.
decisiveLinks = [MARKET_VOLUME] matches Brain's single missing link and the parked buyerVolume question.
Resolution threshold (~110 evidenced reachable agencies, plus purchase frequency) is consistent with the arithmetic.
